info.title: ids
info.description: Cross-platform identifier generator — UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID, NanoID.

options.name: --type
options.description: Identifier type: uuid4, uuid7, ulid, nanoid (default: uuid7)

options.name: --alphabet
options.description: NanoID alphabet: url-safe, alphanum, hex, lower, upper (nanoid only)

options.name: --format
options.description: UUID shape: default, hex, braces, urn (uuid only)

options.name: --describe
options.description:
Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
Exit Codes:
0    Success
1    Unexpected runtime error (e.g. OS CSPRNG failure, OOM)
125  Usage error: bad flags, unknown value, or flag/type mismatch
